revision.scope:
ONE bounded complete nominal support/COM geometry formulation, zero physics/runtime.
Optional exact COMxy targets become support-polygon coordinates with coupled force balance.
Contact, phase, planning, support and hover constraints receive NO feasibility slack.
revision.objective: dimensionless command/rate/headroom/time epigraph slack only; no time objective

row_scale_groups.name: local_command_effort_corner
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: command reserve .03 rad; configured effort limits; whole body weight fraction

row_scale_groups.name: dependent_planning_bounds
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: same .1 m root and 1 rad joint nondimensionalization as357

row_scale_groups.name: increasing_rate
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: one 20 ms interval at actual reserved nominal rates

row_scale_groups.name: decreasing_rate
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: one 20 ms interval at actual reserved nominal rates

row_scale_groups.name: upper_linear_headroom
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: existing .03 rad desired reserve times one 20 ms interval

row_scale_groups.name: lower_linear_headroom
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: existing .03 rad desired reserve times one 20 ms interval

row_scale_groups.name: normal_descent
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: one 20 ms interval at existing 6 mm/s descent cap

row_scale_groups.name: nominal_support_polygon
row_scale_groups.scale_reason: original 5 mm support margin; scaling only

revision.changed_research_target: exact nominal COMxy freed inside original5mm support polygon; force particular changes consistently
